channel.title: Web3 Hub
channel.description: Web3 Hub reports crypto news: Bitcoin and Ethereum, exchanges, DeFi protocols, stablecoins, regulation, security incidents and network upgrades.

item.title: Variational raises $110 million at $1.5 billion valuation
item.description: Variational raised $110 million at a $1.5 billion valuation in a Bain Capital Crypto-led Series B, funding more markets, higher position limits and 24/7 swaps.

item.title: cowswap vs ParaSwap vs Matcha: Which should you use?
item.description: cowswap vs ParaSwap vs Matcha: choose CoW’s batch-auction interface for a safer first swap when supported; use an aggregator for missing chains or tokens.

item.title: How to fix an Ethereum transaction pending for hours safely
item.description: An Ethereum transaction pending for hours usually has a fee below the base fee or a stuck earlier nonce. Learn when to wait, speed up or cancel safely.

item.title: What Is a Token Spender Address?
item.description: A token spender address is the contract you authorize to move approved tokens; learn how ERC-20 allowances, NFT operators and revokecash display it.

item.title: DOJ gets authority to seize $1.2 billion in Binance hack funds
item.description: The Justice Department won court authority to seize or restrain more than $1.2 billion of Binance hack funds as recovery efforts continue across crypto networks.

item.title: How to tell if a DEX website is fake before connecting safely
item.description: To tell if a DEX website is fake before connecting a wallet, open the official domain, compare it character by character and inspect the first prompt.

item.title: Check wallet chain ID before a swap to block wrong-chain requests
item.description: How to check a wallet chain ID before a token swap: call eth_chainId on the selected provider, compare it with your target, and block requests until they match.

item.title: US Gets Authority to Seize $1.2B in Binance Crypto
item.description: The Justice Department says courts authorized seizure or restraint of more than $1.2 billion from the Binance theft as US efforts to recover funds continue.

item.title: What Happens to ETH When a Bridge Locks It
item.description: What happens to my ETH on the Monad bridge? It stays locked on Ethereum while an equal wrapped ETH token is minted on Monad after verification.

item.title: Bitcoin bridge integration checklist: checks before launch
item.description: A bitcoin bridge integration checklist for wallet developers: validate each request, sign the bridge-built transaction, resolve tokens by chain, and track failures by txid.

item.title: How to Move Native USDC Between Chains With CCTP
item.description: How Circle CCTP moves native USDC between chains: it burns USDC on the source, then mints native USDC on the destination after Circle attests the burn.

item.title: US gets court approval to seize $1.2B in Binance crypto
item.description: The Justice Department says courts authorized seizure or restraint of more than $1.2 billion in Binance assets, part of $2.7 billion frozen after October’s theft.

item.title: What happens after approving a Gnosis Bridge withdrawal?
item.description: What happens after approving a token bridge withdrawal? Approval sets an ERC-20 allowance; submit a separate bridge transaction, then track the source and destination.

item.title: Bridged tokens in MetaMask: Ethereum-side import
item.description: How to add a bridged token to MetaMask after a Gnosis Chain withdrawal: claim it on Ethereum, then import its verified Ethereum contract address.

item.title: How energy and bandwidth work on TRON when swaps burn TRX
item.description: How energy and bandwidth work on TRON: swaps use Energy for contract execution, and wallets burn TRX when staking or delegation leaves a shortfall.

item.title: Gnosis Bridge returns tokens to Ethereum through a claim
item.description: How to bridge tokens from Gnosis Chain to Ethereum: submit the return transfer, wait for validation, claim on Ethereum and verify the recipient balance.

item.title: What mistakes happen when adding an EVM network to a wallet?
item.description: Common mistakes when adding a network to a crypto wallet include a wrong Chain ID or RPC, a testnet mix-up and missing tokens; verify each before sending.

item.title: US Wins Court Authority Over $1.2B in Binance Stolen Crypto
item.description: The court-authorized action covers part of the more than $2.7 billion frozen after a $6 billion Binance theft attributed by the FBI to North Korea.

item.title: Injective Veyra vote clears quorum ahead of Nov. 16 close
item.description: Injective proposal 717 has exceeded its 33.4% quorum, with voting open until Nov. 16 and the v1.21.0 upgrade targeted for Nov. 24 if approved.

item.title: US wins authority to seize $1.2 billion in Binance funds
item.description: The Justice Department says it has court authority to seize or restrain $1.2 billion of Binance assets, part of a wider freeze tied to a North Korean hack.
